name: Should I choose quartz or granite for my bathroom vanity countertop?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose quartz or granite for my bathroom vanity countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quartz is engineered from crushed stone and resin, making it completely non-porous, stain-resistant, and maintenance-free without any need for regular sealing. Granite is natural stone, offering unique organic patterns and exceptional heat resistance, but it requires periodic sealing to prevent water and cosmetic stains in humid bathroom spaces. The practical tradeoff comes down to upkeep versus heat tolerance: quartz offers worry-free daily maintenance against makeup and oils, while granite handles hot hair styling tools with less risk of surface discoloration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quartz is non-porous and never needs sealing, making it low-maintenance. Granite provides natural patterns and higher heat resistance, but requires routine sealing.
